t: You're on Newgate Street, in the City of London. The material I have about the street itself is thin, so I'll stick to the people. George Faudel-Phillips, an English politician, lived here. So did William Gordon, an English Independent minister and writer, who lived from 1728 to 1807. Beyond that, I don't have more to tell you about either of them or about the street, and I'd rather say less than guess.
